Getting oil out of the region is expensive, which filters down to consumers. The threat of new attacks can keep oil costs higher, too, thanks to the risk premium embedded in prices. The big picture: Traders are watching the state of potential diplomacy — and the possibility of a prolonged stalemate. Oil prices jumped yesterday after President Trump said on his Truth Social that "we don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed." The Italian Futurist Umberto Boccioni whirled an athlete’s body into a vortex of movement in his 1913 painting Dynamism of a Soccer Player . You can see one of the earliest fine art depictions of a match – a smoggy, factory-adjactent scene called Any Wintry Afternoon in England – at the Manchester Art Gallery. Brian Gutekunst's track record in the first round of the draft has drawn criticism, but he hit a home run with Matthew Golden. The Packers have found good players in round one, but arguably not enough great ones. To some extent that is the price they pay for their success. It is harder to draft stars when picking in the 20's every year. Even the better picks have often taken years to develop into top players. Oregon will be without OLB Teitum Tuioti for the first time in 51 games. Who else is on the availability report for the Ducks with Michigan on tap? As expected, Tuioti was one of eight Ducks listed as out on Wednesday's Big Ten availability report for the 12:30 p.m. PT Saturday game against the Wolverines at Autzen Stadium. John Rigby writes: In cities such as York, cycling and walking grew while accident rates plummeted Mayer Hillman was indeed very perceptive on transport policy issues. But he also had a big impact on transport planning in practice. A European spacecraft has begun close inspections of an asteroid rammed by NASA four years ago in a planetary defense test. The European Space Agency announced Wednesday that the Hera spacecraft is now studying Didymos and its moonlet Dimorphos from just 15 miles to 18 miles (25 kilometers to 30 kilometers) away. NASA's Dart spacecraft deliberately slammed into little Dimorphos in 2022 to see whether such a defensive move might help save Earth from a killer space rock one day. The impact shortened the moonlet's orbit around Didymos. More importantly, it nudged the moonlet into a slightly different path around the sun.

A short ride from Amsterdam, this laid-back city has great museums, cosy bars and a new exhibition featuring the works of Rembrandt and local artist Frans Hals this winter I t’s only 15 minutes away from the Dutch capital by train, but Haarlem feels a million miles from Amsterdam, and perhaps provides a more typical glimpse of the Netherlands than trailing around the well-worn tourist trail of Van Gogh, coffee shops and red lights. An attractive city of cobbled streets, gabled houses and canals, Haarlem is, as the Dutch would say, a gezellig sort of place – cosy, convivial, and full of intriguing nooks and corners. I’ve been coming here for years, and it seems odd that Haarlem is not better…

Today in Boston Celtics history, Frederick Robert Robey extended his contract with the team. For more than 30 years, the paper covered an increasingly repressive state under Vladimir Putin. Novaya Gazeta was a newspaper of near-legendary status in Russia. Nvidia’s chief executive, a confidant of President Trump, successfully pushed for less regulation and open borders for chip sales. Jensen Huang’s ouster as chief executive of Nvidia leaves a vacuum in Washington, where he was one of the strongest bulwarks against the regulation of artificial intelligence. A confidant of President Trump, Mr. Huang successfully fought to open sales channels of A.I. chips to China. He also argued against A.I. safety regulations, which he said could hold back American companies in a global race with rivals. And he pushed for acceptance of open source technology, in which the underlying computer code for A.I. models is made public.

The ruling, which could affect similar laws in other British Commonwealth countries, has spotlighted a legal system still intertwined with a former colonial power. A ruling by a British-based court has invalidated laws criminalizing homosexuality in Trinidad and Tobago, setting a precedent for those challenging similar laws in other nations in the Caribbean and possibly beyond. The 19-year-old Bulgarian racing driver will join a TPC session in Hungary this week. A TPC programme allows F1 teams to run cars from previous seasons. It is usually held in private, giving current drivers, reserve drivers, and young prospects more experience behind the wheel. For reserve drivers, a TPC helps ensure that they are up to par with real F1 machinery, not just the simulators that they typically practice on. Then, for prospects like Tsolov, a session gives F1 engineers the opportunity to observe how young drivers adapt to F1 cars and communicate technical feedback. The TPC can help them understand tyre management, braking, steering inputs, and car behavior.

The American Cancer Society is recommending routine prostate cancer screening for more middle-aged men, in a major change to its guidelines. Middle-aged men should undergo regular screening for prostate cancer, the American Cancer Society said Thursday in a major change to its guidelines. The screening involves a simple blood test, and men at average risk of getting prostate cancer should receive the prostate-specific antigen, or PSA, test every two years between the ages of 50 and 69, the cancer society advised. Men at high risk, including Black men and men with a strong family history of prostate cancer, should get yearly PSA checks and start earlier, at age 45.

Jensen Huang’s affair with a woman U.S. officials say is a Chinese spy has drawn attention to the role of intimate relationships in espionage. At the height of the Cold War, a top official in China’s intelligence agency said that his country would never use seduction to entrap a person. Such tactics might be for the C.I.A. or the K.G.B., the official named Kong Yuan, of the Central Investigation Department, told a group of agents in training in April 1960, but China was guided by principles. Back-to-back systems over the next few days will deliver the season’s first widespread rain. Here’s what to know about the forecast. A string of storms is expected to pummel California with rain, wind, snow and big waves over the next week, bringing the season’s first prolonged stretch of widespread stormy weather to the state. The storms are arriving as the waters off the coast of California are unusually warm and El Niño continues to strengthen. The climate pattern jumbles weather around the globe, often making winters in California wetter than normal and raising sea levels enough to cause flooding.

Jean Powell kept asking when she could go back to her flat, which was flooded when the River Monnow burst its banks. When neighbours hammered on Jean Powell's door and evacuated her to safety because the nearby river had burst its banks and swamped her town, little did she know she would never return home. Jean sought a 10-month refuge at her local Wetherspoons but kept asking when she could go back to her flat, which was flooded when the River Monnow hit 18-times its normal level in south Wales in November 2025 . But the 95-year-old never got to go back home and died in September - one of those who suffered a personal toll from the effects of being flooded.

With the NFL trade deadline behind us, what does the Indianapolis Colts' future salary cap situation now look like? By trading away DeForest Buckner, Quenton Nelson, Josh Downs, and Keenan Allen, the Colts freed up some cap space for the 2026 season, since the team no longer has to pay out portions of those contracts. The Buckner and Nelson contracts specifically cleared over $17.7 million in cap space, according to The Ringer's Tom Pelissero . So, at the moment, the Colts have $33.876 million in available cap space, according to Over the Cap , which is the fourth-most in the NFL. Any unused cap space from the 2026 season can be rolled over into 2027.
